title: Semantic & keyboard pass

resolvedFindings.change: Accessibility coverage expanded from 28 URLs to 51 representative URLs covering every substantive public route pattern, including dynamic detail-page representatives.
Axe run set now includes WCAG 2.0 A/AA, WCAG 2.1 A/AA and axe-core's WCAG 2.2 AA tag.
Every accessibility route now asserts one main landmark, exactly one h1 inside main, no unnamed buttons, no images missing alt, and rejects accidental 404 coverage.
Browser regression verifies Skip to main content is the first keyboard stop and transfers focus to main.
Browser regression verifies Enter opens a desktop family menu and Escape closes it with focus returned to its toggle.
Browser regression verifies ArrowDown changes aria-activedescendant while DOM focus stays on the search input, and Escape closes the popup without losing focus.
Browser regression verifies a named horizontal table region is directly keyboard focusable.
Browser regression verifies pathname navigation transfers focus to main content.
Cross-route fragment navigation now focuses the destination target; temporary tabindex is removed after blur when injected.
Removed redundant onClick behavior from the noninteractive BrandMark wrapper.
Shared breadcrumb links remain semantic navigation and now meet the 44px interaction-height baseline.

preservedStrengths: Breadcrumbs retain nav + aria-label and aria-current.
Navbar retains aria-expanded/aria-controls and Escape behavior.
ScrollToTop preserves same-page fragment behavior while improving cross-route focus.
manualLimits: Axe does not establish full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
Screen-reader announcement quality and reading order still require manual sampling.
Focus visibility, clipping and virtual-keyboard behavior still require device/browser QA.
The browser suite can only execute when CI/current build infrastructure is available.
